units.name: Kitchen basics
units.goal: Cuts precisely at speed; weighs ingredients and works out yield; scales any recipe by hand; writes a prep timeline and runs it

units.name: No-cook
units.goal: Makes and rescues an emulsion; composes cold dishes for guests; holds a cold spread safely

units.name: Clean meat, poultry, and fish
units.goal: Breaks down a whole chicken and trims a cut; matches primal cuts to methods; buys and portions fish; works out yield and cost per serving; knows the clean birds and how to source meat well

units.name: Baking
units.goal: Makes enriched and cold-fermented doughs; laminates a rough puff; blind-bakes a crust; scales a quick bread and times it with a meal; judges a bake by feel and fixes what went wrong

units.name: Boiling, simmering, and steaming
units.goal: Poaches fish and eggs at a held temperature; makes risotto and grains for a crowd; costs a bean dish; reduces a stock and builds a soup from it

units.name: Stovetop
units.goal: Sears to doneness by touch and builds a pan sauce; times a multi-dish stir-fry; cooks eggs to order; builds a cuisine's base from scratch; makes the mother sauces and rescues a broken one; deep-fries at a held temperature

units.name: Oven and grill
units.goal: Roasts whole fish and fish in parchment for guests; grills over two zones; roasts a large cut to doneness with pan juices; bakes a casserole for 12, timing the oven for two pans

units.name: Low and slow
units.goal: Braises tough cuts to fork-tender and lifts off the fat; renders and saves poultry fat; builds a stew that holds safely for hours

units.name: Sabbath capstone
units.goal: Plans, budgets, shops for, and cooks a full Sabbath meal for the household and guests, entirely on their own, from dishes the student writes
